$comment: Rater H, blind. Build 1cb869d, seed 83, phone 400x800@3 via tools/browser.mjs in one browser context. Read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md s1-3, the template. Did not open PLAN.md, research/, CUT docs, other cards or source. Audio: none in build, unassessed. Screens looked at: first minute, first death, first edit, return screen, first edit after return. Second genre: rule-programming autobattler.

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 34 min of cold play; 17 min on return
horizon.$note: Own edits: (1) hp<40% -> return; (2) foe: telegraph -> retreat, dragged above attack; (3) replaced dead 'hp<30% drink heal' with 'on see stray -> tame nearest'; after return (4) re-added hp<30% drink heal at top, (5) moved return above attack, (6) foe: thief -> attack thief above attack. Bought: path: bones, +1 row, card: thief guard (deleted later), cond: on see, 3 heal potions. Deaths read: run 1 ogre D4 (live, full trace + morgue); overnight run 17 ogre D4 (trace + morgue via 'open'); overnight heir-2 ogre death readable only as the reel line 'Ogres chased him to 3 HP; R2 retreated; died to an ogre.' Wanted to come back before seeing the return screen: yes (would Skog survive, would the pair pass the D4 ogre).

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: My cowardly fighter went down with only my new 'return at 40%' rule and sat at 15 of 36 HP, one point above the line, for two whole floors while I watched the bar and the alert climb to '!!!'. On D5 the captain rallied, a goblin captain took one more point and 'R3 · return' fired at 14/36. He walked out with $147 and I kept $88 and a sword +1 from the vault, the run that unlocked the whole shop later.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Probe: yes, several times. The HUD told me 'keeps $88 · return at 40%' and the fight frame said 'R1 TAME JACKAL', so I always knew what my rules were doing; but the trace said 'R1 locked cond' for a condition the picker had let me choose, unlock chips showed 'reach -16%' then 'reach +33%' for the same item, '+1 party' sat disabled with no reason, the forge dots did nothing, 'rest 20m' was never explained, and in run 6 'hp < 30% -> drink heal' did not fire at 9/38 with three heal potions bought and no trace exists for a returned run. Adequate: the core feedback is clear, the surrounding panels are not.

Probe: I put 'hp < 40% -> return' below 'foes >= 1 -> attack' and it cost a death ('R3 attacked; died to ogre' at 11 HP); after the return I moved it above and the next two runs came home at 6/38 and 7/38. I would make the 40% call again (it turned death-keeps-0% into return-keeps-60%) but I saw the cost in 'R4 return ended 4 runs at D4'. Lapse: unlock purchases are bought blind ('path: bones' changed nothing I could see) and the forecast for the same rule set drifted D4 57% -> 70% -> 58% -> 64%, so the numbers I chose by are noisy.

Probe: an hour in I know rule order is the whole game (a retreat rule above attack means 'R3 retreat caught him'; a return rule below attack never fires in a fight), that the thief needs its own row, and that 'drink heal' is dead until silver = heal is learned. The game taught this only through deaths; the two things I still cannot explain (heal not firing in run 6, the disabled '+1 party') are why it is adequate not strong.

Probe: I sweated when the hero held 15/36 (41.7%) for two floors one point above my 40% return line while the alert went '!' -> '!!' -> '!!!' and he took the stairs to D5 anyway; the game noticed with 'return keeps 60% -> $88' against 'death keeps 0% -> $0'. Lapse: at 'slow' speed the same stretch is 20-30 s of 'attack x no target' where nothing I own can change, and once the return rule sits on top every run ends at D3-D4 with 0 marks, so the doubt drains out.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Probe: the fight frame is what felt good: camera snaps in, 'R3 RETREAT' banner over 'OGRE WINDS UP' with the named ogre MORETH, the hero flashes white on a hit and '-6 ogre' floats up. Audio unassessed (none). At 'fast' there is an event every 2-3 s; at 'slow' floors took ~100 s with 20 s stretches of 'pick up' and 'attack x no path'.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Probe: 'A thief snatched the sword / the speed potion / the invisibility potion' three runs running made me buy the thief-guard card and then write 'foe: thief -> attack thief'; 'ogre winds up' made me write the telegraph-retreat rule; 'Skog the jackal, gone wild' made me swap my dead heal rule for 'on see stray -> tame nearest'. Repeats: every run walks D1-D4 of 'the Warrens', the ogre is 100% of forecast deaths and killed all four heirs, so by run 6 the shape of a run was known.

Probe: to a friend: 'a cowardly tamer who runs from anything that winds up, stabs thieves first, and walks home at 40% health with a jackal called Skog'. 'yours: 5 of 6 rows' and the HUD quoting 'return at 40%' made it mine, but the set is five threshold lines the offered patches could equally have written, and the chronicle still calls it the '"fighter" set'.

Probe: 'Ogres chased him to 3 HP; R2 retreated; died to an ogre.' and 'Grog the jackal fell.' are reel lines I can retell, and the chronicle gives each heir a line ('the cowardly fighter · D5 · found #1's bones · tamed a jackal · fell to an ogre'). But five of the seven reel sentences are the same template with numbers swapped ('The nest chased him to 25 HP; R3 attacked; reached D4.'), returned runs never enter the chronicle, and the run I would actually tell (the 41.7% run) has no line anywhere.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 'fast' is a good watch (an event every 2-3 s, a floor a minute); 'slow' is dead (~100 s per floor, 20 s of 'pick up'). Check-in: the return check-in was ~6 min from 'rested 348m' to 'send', a chosen stopping point. Cadence: only the 8 h absence was taken, and it produced a different experience (17 runs, a STALL diagnosis) from a 5-min run. Lapses: the unlock list is a 40-chip scroll every visit, 'rest 20m' next to send is unexplained, and the 'CHOOSE ONE' vault prompt resolves itself in ~3 s.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Probe: the first death was 'ogre · D4 · 6 over · 6 unknown unused · gap' with a per-tick trace 'R2 attack nearest hp 1 foes 1 · R1 unknown item' and three patches with 'survives 83% · base 0%'; the second was 'ogre · D4 · 10 over · heal unused · gap' with 'R1 locked cond · R2 no path'. Whose fault: mine, both times, and the screen said which row. The next heir starts on the next tap. Lapse: only the latest death keeps its trace; the other overnight death survives as one reel sentence, and returned runs get no trace at all.

Probe: nobody asked me to tame a jackal; I wrote 'on see stray -> tame nearest' because the reel said 'Skog the jackal, gone wild', and 'R1 TAME JACKAL / TAMED!' followed. Otherwise the game steers hard: three patches under every death, a STALL card telling me what to change, 'PENDING: R1 never fired'.

Within-run: gold, 'sword +1' from vault rooms, fighter L1 -> L2. Between-run: the verb list grew from 'drink unknown' to 'drink heal / strength / speed / invisibility / caustic / fire' and 'read teleport / blink / fear' overnight, renown star 0 -> 2, a bestiary ledger with 9 of ~40 rows known, ◆ marks (5, 1, 0, +6 overnight). Automation growth: 'auto: keep weapon+armour ◆5 / restock ◆4 / insure ◆6' are listed but with 2-6 marks per session I never afforded one, so that layer is unobserved; hence 0.6.

Probe: an olive-and-black pixel dungeon with a lone shield-bearer, a running jackal sprite and pixel-font banners; 'the Warrens', 'A den. Something sleeps.' I would not sit in it doing nothing, but it is legible and consistent, and the fight-frame close-ups have some weight. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Probe: I came back to '17 RUNS · D6 BEST · ◆+6 · 15 RETURNED · 2 DEATHS · rested 348m', a STALL card 'R4 return ended 4 runs at D4', 'LOST ◯ Skog x2', 'HATCHED jackal x2', 'R1 never fired: see stray -> tame', and twenty identified potions that opened a shop. Because of it I bought 'cond: on see', moved the return rule above attack, re-added drink heal, chose Grog and bought three heal potions, all inside six minutes. Would I rather have stayed: no. Lapse: 8 h of absence gave ◆6 against ◆5 for my first 20-minute run, and I could not open the second overnight death; scored same-day, per the brief.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Probe: 'The last run ended when my retreat rule kept firing under the ogre's wind-ups and the reel said R3 retreat caught him; I put retreat above attack, so that was me.' 'heal unused' was me deleting the heal row; 'R1 locked cond' was me picking a locked condition; 'TAMED!' was my row. Of the three deaths read, all three end in a row I wrote or reordered. Lapse: run 6's 'hp < 30% -> drink heal' silently not firing at 9/38 is a loss I cannot connect to anything I configured.
